purpose: Allow successful slow monitoring only in provably inactive gaps, without accepting it as a clean measurement sample
idle_delay_requirements: no foreign process or resource violation
measurement_policy: before/during/after queries retain the 2 second limit; query errors always abort; launch requires a fresh successful before sample no older than 2 seconds
audit: Verify idle delay intervals do not overlap any run and later launches follow fresh before samples using monotonic timestamps
budget: Use the existing returned campaign deadline; do not reset the reservation clock
limitations: Periodic monitoring cannot rule out interference between observations; historical standalone original_compare auditors conservatively reject idle delay exceptions
